channel.description: Recent content in Machine-Learning on Markus Knauer

item.title: MOMO: Seamless Physical, Verbal, and Graphical Robot Skill Adaptation
item.author: (Markus Knauer)
item.description: MOMO: A framework unifying physical, verbal, and graphical modalities for interactive robot skill learning and adaptation. Validated on a 7-DoF torque-controlled robot at Automatica 2025.

item.title: CLASP: Natural Language-Driven Robot Skill Selection and Composition
item.author: (Markus Knauer)
item.description: CLASP: A modular framework combining Vision-Language Models with Task-Parameterized KMPs for data-efficient, language-driven robot skill selection, composition, and active acquisition.

item.title: RA-L 2026: IROSA — Interactive Robot Skill Adaptation using Natural Language
item.author: (Markus Knauer)
item.description: IROSA: A tool-based framework enabling open-vocabulary robot skill adaptation through natural language using LLMs and Kernelized Movement Primitives. Published in IEEE RA-L 2026.

item.title: Summer Schools 2025: ELLIS Cambridge & OxML Oxford
item.author: (Markus Knauer)
item.description: My experience at two world-class summer schools: ELLIS Cambridge (Probabilistic ML) and OxML Oxford (Representation Learning & Generative AI). Key insights and program highlights.

item.title: RA-L 2025: LOCI — Interactive Incremental Learning of Generalizable Robot Skills
item.author: (Markus Knauer)
item.description: LOCI: A probabilistic machine learning method for interactive robot skill modulation using a task-parameterized, kernelized approach (TP-KMP). Published in IEEE RA-L 2025.

item.title: Project: BlenderProc — Photorealistic Rendering for Computer Vision (3.4k+ GitHub Stars)
item.author: (Markus Knauer)
item.description: Popular open source project for fast creation of training images for deep neural networks in computer vision.

item.title: IROS 2022: RECALL — Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning for Object Classification
item.author: (Markus Knauer)
item.description: RECALL: A novel rehearsal-free continual learning approach for object classification achieving SOTA results. Published at IEEE IROS 2022.
